We move sensitive keys into secret managers, establish strict TypeScript models, create modular backend routing, enforce database indexing, and build automated CI/CD deployment pipelines to make the app resilient under real user traffic.

items.answer: Our engineering pods deploy within 48 hours of completing the initial technical scoping call. We plug directly into your GitHub organization, Linear/Jira boards, and Slack workspace with zero prolonged onboarding procedures.
items.question: How quickly can your engineering pod start on our codebase?

items.answer: Both. We build fully native iOS applications in Swift / SwiftUI and native Android applications in Kotlin / Jetpack Compose for hardware-intensive requirements. For founders targeting both platforms simultaneously with shared logic, we deploy React Native architectures.
items.question: Do you build native or cross-platform mobile apps?

items.answer: Yes. Our senior engineers operate inside your branch conventions, submit standard pull requests, and participate in peer code reviews alongside your in-house team.
items.question: Can our internal developers work alongside your pod?

items.answer: You retain 100% ownership of all source code, documentation, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure configurations from day one. All code is committed directly to your private repositories.
items.question: Who owns the intellectual property and code written during the sprint?

items.answer: Our two-week backlog sprints are billed 100% upfront to reserve the engineering calendar. Greenfield MVPs and Vibe-Code Overhauls operate on a 50% deposit and 50% upon delivery milestone completion.
